app.gleitzeitkonto_digitales_berichtsheft_ue:
Flextime account, digital report book, overtime calculator & working-time record.
                100% offline, GDPR-compliant, and designed for your apprenticeship.
app.prinzipien_die_jede_zeile_code: Principles that guide every line of code and every decision.
app.daten_gehoeren_dem_nutzer_keine: Data belongs to the user. No telemetry, no tracking pixels, no third parties. Zero-knowledge as an architectural principle.
app.jede_codezeile_wird_reviewed_getestet: Every line of code is reviewed, tested and optimized. We don't ship "good enough" — we ship the best.
app.kostenlos_open_source_fuer_jeden: Free, open source, accessible to everyone. Education and tools shouldn't be behind a paywall.
app.gleitzeitkonto_digitales_berichtsheft_ue: Flextime account, digital report book & overtime calculator – free, offline, GDPR-compliant. Join over 50 apprentices.

showcase.professionelle_werkzeuge_die_sich_nahtlo: Professional tools that integrate seamlessly into your everyday work — from your very first hour to your final certificate.
showcase.erfasse_arbeitszeiten_mit_einem_tap: Log your working hours with a single tap. The system learns your pattern, detects anomalies and optimizes your flextime account automatically.
showcase.aes256gcm_verschluesselung_zeroknowledge: AES-256-GCM encryption, zero-knowledge architecture, no data transfer. GDPR by design.
showcase.service_worker_cachen_die_gesamte: Service workers cache the entire app. No internet? No problem. Full functionality — everywhere.
showcase.webrtcbasierter_geraetesync_ohne_middlew: WebRTC-based device sync without middleware. Data flows directly from device to device — encrypted.
showcase.berichtsheftgenerierung_mit_ondevice_int: Report-book generation with on-device intelligence. No cloud API, no cost, no data sharing.

features.alles_was_azubis_fuer_die: Everything apprentices need for time tracking
features.gleitzeitkonto_berichtsheft_ueberstunden: Flextime account, report book, overtime calculator – one app for everything around your apprenticeship.
features.als_progressive_web_app_laedt: As a Progressive Web App, MyWorkLog loads in milliseconds, works completely offline and feels like a native apprentice time-tracking app.
features.dein_berichtsheft_und_gleitzeitkonto_ble: Your report book and flextime account stay local on your device. AES-256 encryption, no server, no forced cloud. Privacy by design.
features.der_integrierte_assistent_nutzt_intellig: The built-in assistant uses smart rules & mathematical formulas to evaluate working hours automatically and support your report book.
features.dein_gleitzeitkonto_auf_einen_blick: Your flextime account at a glance: interactive charts, heatmaps, trend analyses – keep overtime and working hours under control.
features.berichtsheft_und_zeiterfassung_auf_handy: Report book and time tracking on phone and PC: WebRTC peer-to-peer sync transfers your flextime account between devices – without a server.
features.ob_fachinformatiker_kaufmaennische_oder_: Whether IT specialist, commercial or industrial apprenticeship – MyWorkLog adapts to your report-book and working-time model.

journey.von_der_ersten_idee_bis: From the first idea to the leading time-tracking solution.

tlP1.aus_der_frustration_ueber_komplizierte: Out of frustration with complicated and unintuitive time-tracking tools, the vision of MyWorkLog was born: time tracking that's actually fun.

tlP2.mit_progressive_web_app_features: With Progressive Web App features, MyWorkLog becomes the first choice for modern time tracking. Offline-first architecture and native app performance.

tlP3.regelbasierte_intelligente_analysen_und_: Rule-based intelligent analytics and automated insights help apprentices manage their working hours and report book optimally.

tlP4.mit_ueber_200_nutzern_weltweit: With over 200 users worldwide, we're delivering the next generation of time-tracking tools for apprentices.

team.ein_team_mit_einer_gemeinsamen: A team with a shared vision: reinventing time tracking.
team.leidenschaft_fuer_privacyfirst_loesungen: Passionate about privacy-first solutions and perfect user experience.

__metaDescription: MyWorkLog is the free time-tracking app for apprentices. Digital report book, flextime account, overtime calculator & working-time record — 100% offline, GDPR-compliant.
